properties.value: TFC polyamide RO; FRP pressure vessels; 316L/duplex HP pump; PVC/PP/PVDF/316L-EP distribution as service requires
properties.note: scope: T-2001/P-2001/MMF-2001/GF-2001/CF-2001/UF-2001/P-2002/RO-2001/T-2002/P-2005/CF-2002/T-2003/P-2003/CIP-2001; alt: Ti Grade 2 wetted parts where chloride drives the HP-pump/tube selection; status FIRM | D-A2000-MOC: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.

properties.value: RO feed must be oxidiser-free and within scaling limits (BaSO₄ / CaSO₄); lime-stage gypsum saturation ≈ 1,480 mg/L sulphate governs recovery; NaOH upstream makes RO unworkable (Na₂SO₄ 61 g/L)
properties.note: D-A2000-02: RO feed must be oxidiser-free and within BaSO₄ / CaSO₄ scaling limits; gypsum saturation ≈ 1,480 mg/L governs recovery; no NaOH upstream (Na₂SO₄ 61 g/L makes RO unworkable) — adopted as the process constraint.

properties.value: Clean sources only (W3): RO-2001A/B polish the A-1100 concentrator condensate — 2.6 m³/h normal, 3.0 m³/h at the 150 t/d rating, 85 % recovery, ≈ 2.2 m³/h permeate; the A-1000 effluent (≈ 6–29 g/L chloride by HCl case) goes to sewer and is not reclaimed
properties.note: D-A2000-03; closes D-A2000-01 | D-A2000-03: A-2000 on clean sources only (W3, bases A2-1–A2-8, FEED-PE-CAL-036): on the Case 4 volumes the A-300 phase 2 HCl leaves ≈ 5.9–29 g/L chloride (≈ 12–48 g/L TDS) in the A-1000 effluent, so reclaiming it would need brackish-to-seawater RO and 4–26 t/d of soda-ash softening against ≈ 380 m³/d of municipal water. A-2000 polishes the A-1100 condensate (carbon + 1 + 1 RO, ≈ 2.2 m³/h) and takes ≈ 15.8 m³/h of municipal make-up for the 18 m³/h demand; the A-1000 effluent goes to sewer.
